title: Code and data: light-transport models and machine-learning surrogate for plasmonic photothermal planning
description: Python code (Gans optics, Beer-Lambert, delta-P1 and Monte Carlo light transport, Pennes bioheat, CEM43 dose, ANN/XGBoost surrogates) and data (digitised temperatures, 422,304-sample design dataset) for the article 'Which light-transport model is needed for plasmonic photothermal planning?'.
